Accountants who know how a building job runs

Subbies to verify on a Friday afternoon, a CIS return due on the 19th, reverse charge on one invoice and not the next, retentions you’re still waiting on. We deal with all of that so you can stay on site.

Your subbies, sorted

New subbies verified with HMRC before you pay them, your CIS300 filed by the 19th and deduction statements sent out, so no £100 late-filing penalties. CIS taken off you is reconciled, and reverse charge VAT is applied to the right invoices.

A plan every quarter

Not just a tax return once a year. Every quarter we sit down and answer the real questions: can you afford the new van, what do you put aside for January, which jobs are actually making money.

An accountant who knows you

The same accountant from your first call through every quarterly review. Xero, bank feeds and digital receipts keep everything up to date.

Packages and fees

Choose the support you need. We confirm a fixed quote based on your workload. Every package includes monthly CIS for your subcontractors, quarterly reviews and a first-month Finance MOT. All prices are monthly and exclude VAT. Your Xero subscription is billed at cost on top, with no markup, so you only pay what Xero charges.

The small things that cost contractors money

A missing invoice. A late payment. A cost missed on a job. Here’s why we look beyond the paperwork.

Illustrative examples · fictional figures

01 / Missing VAT invoice

£200

VAT to check

£1,200 spent on materials, including £200 VAT. The invoice is missing.

Less cash available for the next job.

Missing evidence can delay a valid VAT claim, leaving more to pay or less to reclaim.

Next: find the invoice, check the VAT claim.

02 / Overdue customer invoices

£8,400

still unpaid

The work is finished. The payment hasn’t arrived.

You’re funding the gap.

Wages and suppliers still need paying, even when your customer is late.

Next: check what’s overdue, agree next steps.

03 / Costs missing from a job

£2,000

margin overstated

Labour and materials recorded, but not allocated to the right job.

The job looks better than it is.

Missing £2,000 of costs from the job report makes its margin look £2,000 higher.

Next: match the costs, review the true margin.

Examples show issues we can investigate, not actual client results or guaranteed savings. VAT example assumes a VAT-registered business, standard-rate materials and eligible business use. Any corrective work is agreed separately.

Questions contractors ask

Does Foundation include Making Tax Digital?

Yes, with quarterly MTD for Income Tax updates where required. We check whether MTD applies to you when you start.

Who do you work with?

Established tradespeople and contractors with at least one or two regular subcontractors, as a sole trader or a limited company. If you don’t use subbies yet, book a call anyway and we’ll tell you honestly whether we’re the right fit.

Can you help with CIS and construction VAT?

Yes. We verify subbies, file your monthly CIS300 and send deduction statements, and reconcile the CIS taken off you so it’s claimed back against your PAYE or tax bill. Foundation and Build cover up to 2 subbies and Develop up to 5. We apply the domestic reverse charge where it applies and standard VAT where it doesn’t, for example on work for end users.

Can you help me get gross payment status?

Yes. With gross payment status, contractors pay you without the 20% CIS deduction, which makes a big difference to cash flow. We check whether you meet HMRC’s business, turnover and compliance tests, fix anything that would hold you back, and help you apply.

Can you help with cash-flow forecasting?

Yes. It’s included in custom packages, or we can add it to any package with a tailored quote covering the period, how often it’s updated and what information we need.

What happens when I book a call?

Pick a time in the booking calendar for a free 20-minute call, share a little about your business, and we’ll talk through what you need. You can email instead if you prefer.

What if I outgrow my package?

No package has a minimum turnover. Crossing a turnover band doesn’t automatically raise your fee. Any change is agreed before extra work starts.
